response_html:
Admission Offer

Dear {{ applicant_name or applicant_doc.candidate_name or "Applicant" }},

We are pleased to inform you that, following a comprehensive review of your application during {{ admission_cycle.cycle_name }}, you have been offered admission to the program listed below at {{ campus.campus_name or "our institution" }}.

Your academic achievements and potential impressed our admissions committee, and we believe you will make a valuable addition to our academic community.

Program: {{ program.program_name or "N/A" }}
Program Level: {{ program.program_level or "N/A" }}
Department: {{ program.department or "N/A" }}
Duration: {{ program.program_duration or "-" }} Years
Campus: {{ campus.campus_name or "N/A" }} {% if campus.city %}, {{ campus.city }}{% endif %} {% if campus.state %}, {{ campus.state }}{% endif %}
Offer ID: {{ doc.offer_id or doc.name }}
Offer Valid Until: {{ frappe.utils.formatdate(doc.valid_till, "dd MMMM yyyy") if doc.valid_till else "Not specified" }}
Admission Cycle: {{ admission_cycle.cycle_name or "" }} {% if admission_cycle.start_date and admission_cycle.end_date %} ({{ frappe.utils.formatdate(admission_cycle.start_date, "dd MMM yyyy") }} - {{ frappe.utils.formatdate(admission_cycle.end_date, "dd MMM yyyy") }}) {% endif %}

To confirm your acceptance of this offer, please complete the initial admission payment and submit the required confirmation before the specified deadline.

Payable Amount: ₹{{ doc.payable_amount or "0" }}
Payment Deadline: {{ frappe.utils.formatdate(doc.payment_deadline, "dd MMMM yyyy") if doc.payment_deadline else "Not specified" }}

Accept Offer & Pay Fee

Your official offer letter document is attached to this email. Please review it carefully as it contains important information regarding your enrollment conditions, payment policies, and next steps.

If you have any questions or require assistance with the admission process, please contact our admissions office:

Email: {{ campus.contact_email or "admissions@university.edu" }}
Phone: {{ applicant_doc.mobile_number or "N/A" }}

We congratulate you once again on your admission and look forward to welcoming you to {{ campus.campus_name or "our institution" }}.

Warm regards,

Admissions Office
